name: What is the renovation process from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: What is the renovation process from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our renovation process typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. This is followed by design and planning, where we create detailed blueprints and material selections. Once designs are approved and permits obtained, we move to the construction phase, including demolition, framing, rough-ins for electrical and plumbing, insulation, drywall, and finish work like cabinetry and painting. The project concludes with a final walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction. Throughout, we maintain clear communication and manage all aspects.
acceptedAnswer.description: The renovation process starts with consultation, moves to design and planning, then to construction including permits, demolition, and finishing, and concludes with a final walkthrough.
